describe: A soft, intimate adult female narrator, calm and thoughtful, gentle storytelling voice, unhurried and measured, close to the microphone, studio quality
line: Most people never notice the moment their life changes. For her, it was a Tuesday, a cold coffee, and a message she almost did not open.
made_with: openbmb/VoxCPM2 voice design (description only; no person's recording)

openai.persona:
Voice: a soft, intimate female narrator, calm and thoughtful, close to the microphone, natural and human, never breathy, never theatrical.
Pacing: measured but moving, about 190 words a minute while speaking, with a real pause only where a thought lands.
Melody: natural pitch movement with conviction; sentences end with a firm fall.
Stress: words written in capitals carry the line. Hit each one clearly: louder and higher than the words around it.
Numbers and names land crisp and exact.
openai.chosen: 13 Nov voice study (.valmera/week-1112/lanes/VOICE): pitch range, pace and match to the reference narrators
